definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
sentence: He {deceived} everyone about where the money came from.
translation: Он всех обманул насчёт того, откуда взялись деньги.

definition: a narrow passage of water between two areas of land
sentence: Ships pass through the {strait} on their way to the Black Sea.
translation: Корабли проходят через пролив по пути в Чёрное море.

definition: to make an exact copy of something, or to repeat an experiment
sentence: Other labs failed to {replicate} the surprising result.
translation: Другим лабораториям не удалось воспроизвести удивительный результат.

definition: the list of people a company pays, or the total amount it pays them
sentence: The firm has two hundred workers on its {payroll}.
translation: В штате фирмы двести работников.

definition: a way of thinking about a subject, or a place with a good view
sentence: From the customer's {viewpoint}, the new fees are simply unfair.
translation: С точки зрения клиента, новые сборы просто несправедливы.

definition: a book of maps
sentence: The old {atlas} still shows countries that no longer exist.
translation: В старом атласе всё ещё показаны страны, которых больше нет.

definition: the use of machines to do work instead of people
sentence: {Automation} cut the number of jobs at the port by half.
translation: Автоматизация сократила число рабочих мест в порту вдвое.

definition: a feeling of great respect mixed with fear or wonder
sentence: The children stared in {awe} at the huge whale skeleton.
translation: Дети с благоговением смотрели на огромный скелет кита.

definition: soldiers who fight on horseback, or today in armoured vehicles
sentence: The {cavalry} charged across the field at dawn.
translation: Кавалерия атаковала через поле на рассвете.

definition: having bright colours, or full of interest and variety
sentence: The market is {colorful}, with piles of red peppers and yellow lemons.
translation: Рынок яркий, с горами красных перцев и жёлтых лимонов.

definition: a political system in which the state owns all property and shares it among people
sentence: Under {communism}, the factory belonged to the state.
translation: При коммунизме завод принадлежал государству.

definition: able to make decisions quickly, or settling something finally
sentence: Her {decisive} action saved the company from collapse.
translation: Её решительные действия спасли компанию от краха.

definition: made to look attractive rather than to be useful
sentence: The old fireplace is purely {decorative}; it does not work.
translation: Старый камин чисто декоративный, он не работает.

definition: final and not to be changed, or the best and most complete
sentence: The judge's ruling is {definitive}; there will be no more appeals.
translation: Решение судьи окончательное, апелляций больше не будет.

definition: time without end, or a period that feels very long
sentence: The ten minutes in the waiting room felt like an {eternity}.
translation: Десять минут в приёмной показались вечностью.

definition: the act of removing or taking something out
sentence: The {extraction} of the tooth took only a few minutes.
translation: Удаление зуба заняло всего несколько минут.

definition: containing a lot of fat
sentence: Doctors told him to avoid {fatty} food after the heart attack.
translation: После сердечного приступа врачи велели ему избегать жирной пищи.

definition: so dirty that it is unpleasant to touch
sentence: The boys came home {filthy} after playing in the mud.
translation: Мальчики пришли домой грязные после игры в грязи.

definition: a race or event in which any style is allowed, especially in swimming
sentence: She won the hundred metres {freestyle} by half a second.
translation: Она выиграла сто метров вольным стилем с отрывом в полсекунды.

definition: grandfather, used in informal speech
sentence: My {grandpa} taught me to fish on this river.
translation: Мой дедушка научил меня рыбачить на этой реке.

definition: covered with a lot of fur or growth, or frightening and risky
sentence: The spider was big, black and {hairy}.
translation: Паук был большой, чёрный и волосатый.

definition: money or property you receive from someone when they die
sentence: She used her {inheritance} to buy a small farm.
translation: Она потратила наследство на покупку маленькой фермы.

definition: saying the opposite of what you mean, or strange because unexpected
sentence: It is {ironic} that the fire station burned down.
translation: Иронично, что сгорела именно пожарная часть.

definition: the bags and cases you take with you when you travel
sentence: Your {luggage} must weigh less than twenty kilos.
translation: Ваш багаж должен весить меньше двадцати килограммов.

definition: mostly or mainly
sentence: The audience was {predominantly} young, under twenty-five.
translation: Публика была преимущественно молодой, младше двадцати пяти.

definition: belonging to a very early stage of development, or very simple
sentence: The {primitive} tools were made of bone and stone.
translation: Примитивные орудия были сделаны из кости и камня.

definition: relating to powers of the mind that cannot be explained by science
sentence: She claims to have {psychic} powers and talk to the dead.
translation: Она утверждает, что обладает экстрасенсорными способностями и говорит с мёртвыми.

definition: relating to producing babies or young
sentence: The clinic offers advice on {reproductive} health to young couples.
translation: Клиника консультирует молодые пары по вопросам репродуктивного здоровья.

definition: morally right and good, or caused by a feeling that you are right
sentence: She felt a {righteous} anger when she saw the child being hit.
translation: Она почувствовала праведный гнев, увидев, как бьют ребёнка.

definition: having a strong hot taste
sentence: The curry was so {spicy} that my eyes watered.
translation: Карри был таким острым, что у меня слезились глаза.

definition: easily holding on to what it touches, like glue or honey
sentence: The table was {sticky} from the children's juice.
translation: Стол был липкий от детского сока.

definition: enough for a particular purpose
sentence: The ice was not {sufficiently} thick to walk on.
translation: Лёд был недостаточно толстым, чтобы по нему ходить.

definition: used to say that you are glad something bad did not happen
sentence: {Thankfully}, the rain stopped just before the wedding.
translation: К счастью, дождь прекратился прямо перед свадьбой.

definition: coming after nineteen others in a series
sentence: The castle was turned into a hotel in the {twentieth} century.
translation: В двадцатом веке замок превратили в отель.

definition: not enjoyable or not friendly
sentence: There is an {unpleasant} smell coming from the fridge.
translation: Из холодильника идёт неприятный запах.

definition: not connected with something, or not of the same family
sentence: The two fires on the same night were completely {unrelated}.
translation: Два пожара в одну ночь были совершенно не связаны между собой.

definition: empty and available, used about rooms, jobs and buildings
sentence: The flat upstairs has been {vacant} since the old man died.
translation: Квартира наверху пустует с тех пор, как умер старик.

definition: the area near a particular place
sentence: There is no bank in the {vicinity} of the station.
translation: Рядом с вокзалом нет ни одного банка.

definition: a tall cupboard for clothes, or all the clothes a person owns
sentence: Hang the coats in the {wardrobe} in the hall.
translation: Повесь пальто в шкаф в прихожей.

definition: the state of being warm, or friendly and kind feelings
sentence: The {warmth} of the fire slowly brought feeling back to his hands.
translation: Тепло огня постепенно вернуло чувствительность его рукам.

definition: a situation in which someone understands something wrongly, or a small argument
sentence: There was a {misunderstanding} about the time of the meeting.
translation: Произошло недоразумение насчёт времени встречи.

definition: to collect or gain something such as support or information
sentence: The film managed to {garner} praise from even the harshest critics.
translation: Фильму удалось снискать похвалу даже самых строгих критиков.

definition: a very small copy of something, or a very small painting
sentence: The museum has a {miniature} of the whole city in the entrance hall.
translation: В музее в вестибюле стоит миниатюрная модель всего города.

definition: to become or make steady and unlikely to change
sentence: Doctors worked all night to {stabilize} the patient.
translation: Врачи всю ночь работали, чтобы стабилизировать состояние пациента.

definition: a small container that fits into a machine, holding ink, film or bullets
sentence: The printer stopped because the ink {cartridge} was empty.
translation: Принтер остановился, потому что картридж с чернилами опустел.

definition: a piece of wood, thick at one end, used to hold something in place
sentence: Put a {wedge} under the door to keep it open.
translation: Подложи клин под дверь, чтобы она оставалась открытой.

definition: not tight, or not doing work carefully enough
sentence: The rope was too {slack} to hold the boat in place.
translation: Верёвка была слишком слабо натянута, чтобы удержать лодку.

definition: a king or queen
sentence: The {monarch} opens parliament every autumn with a speech.
translation: Монарх открывает парламент каждую осень речью.

definition: a situation in which something cannot continue normally
sentence: Snow caused serious {disruption} to trains across the north.
translation: Снег вызвал серьёзные сбои в движении поездов на севере.

definition: a person who writes the words and music of songs
sentence: The {songwriter} sold her first song at nineteen.
translation: Автор песен продала свою первую песню в девятнадцать.

definition: a chemical substance made of many small units joined in long chains, such as plastic
sentence: Nylon was the first {polymer} made entirely in a factory.
translation: Нейлон стал первым полимером, полностью созданным на заводе.

definition: to add a number to itself several times, or to increase greatly
sentence: {Multiply} the price by three to get the cost for the weekend.
translation: Умножь цену на три, чтобы получить стоимость на выходные.

definition: noisy or violent behaviour in public, or something that stops normal activity
sentence: Police were called to a {disturbance} outside the pub.
translation: Полицию вызвали из-за беспорядков у паба.

definition: a religious song of praise, usually sung in church
sentence: The choir sang a {hymn} at the end of the wedding.
translation: В конце свадьбы хор спел гимн.

definition: to improve the quality of something by adding to it
sentence: Travel will {enrich} your life in ways money cannot.
translation: Путешествия обогатят вашу жизнь так, как не смогут деньги.

definition: to change the shape, sound or meaning of something so it is no longer true
sentence: Heat can {distort} the plastic lid so it no longer fits.
translation: От жары пластиковая крышка может деформироваться и больше не подходить.

definition: firm and dry in a pleasant way, or fresh and cold, used of air
sentence: The apples from the market were sweet and {crisp}.
translation: Яблоки с рынка были сладкие и хрустящие.

definition: a person who likes making people laugh, or an extra playing card
sentence: He is the {joker} of the office and keeps everyone laughing.
translation: Он главный шутник в офисе и всех смешит.

definition: having a lot of wet weather
sentence: Bring a coat; the forecast says the weekend will be {rainy}.
translation: Возьми куртку, прогноз обещает дождливые выходные.

definition: a unit for liquid, about half a litre, or a glass of beer
sentence: He ordered a {pint} and sat down by the window.
translation: Он заказал пинту пива и сел у окна.

definition: a person who dies or suffers for their beliefs
sentence: The church remembers the {martyr} with a feast every July.
translation: Церковь чтит память мученика праздником каждый июль.

definition: a small group of musicians, actors or dancers who perform together
sentence: A jazz {ensemble} played in the hotel lobby every evening.
translation: Джазовый ансамбль играл в холле отеля каждый вечер.

definition: to breathe quickly and loudly, or to blow out small amounts of smoke or air
sentence: By the top of the stairs he was starting to {puff}.
translation: К верху лестницы он начал пыхтеть.

definition: to make an exact copy of something, or to do again what is already done
sentence: Please do not {duplicate} work that another team has finished.
translation: Пожалуйста, не повторяйте работу, которую уже закончила другая команда.

definition: the act of taking money that you will pay back later, or the amount taken
sentence: Government {borrowing} rose sharply during the crisis.
translation: Государственные заимствования резко выросли во время кризиса.

definition: to use a law or rule as a reason for an action
sentence: The president may {invoke} emergency powers during a flood.
translation: Президент может прибегнуть к чрезвычайным полномочиям во время наводнения.

definition: an area of land covered with trees
sentence: Deer live in the {woodland} behind the farm.
translation: Олени живут в лесу за фермой.

definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product if it breaks within a period
sentence: The washing machine comes with a two-year {warranty}.
translation: Стиральная машина идёт с двухлетней гарантией.

definition: a person or company that pays to show its products to the public
sentence: The biggest {advertiser} on the site is a car company.
translation: Крупнейший рекламодатель на сайте — автомобильная компания.

definition: to state firmly and publicly that something is true
sentence: The minister went on TV to {affirm} his support for the plan.
translation: Министр выступил по телевидению, чтобы подтвердить свою поддержку плана.

definition: a group of vehicles or ships travelling together, often with protection
sentence: The aid {convoy} reached the town after a three-day journey.
translation: Колонна с гуманитарной помощью добралась до города после трёхдневного пути.

definition: a person or thing that keeps someone or something safe
sentence: The old dog saw himself as the {protector} of the children.
translation: Старый пёс считал себя защитником детей.

definition: a piece of cloth worn around the neck or head for warmth or decoration
sentence: She wrapped a wool {scarf} around her neck against the wind.
translation: Она обмотала шею шерстяным шарфом от ветра.

definition: to separate something from a supply of power, water or the internet
sentence: Please {disconnect} the printer before you move it.
translation: Пожалуйста, отключи принтер, прежде чем переносить его.

definition: the act of having your hair cut, or the style it is cut in
sentence: He needs a {haircut} before the wedding on Saturday.
translation: Ему нужно подстричься перед свадьбой в субботу.

definition: to make something worse in quality, or to treat someone without respect
sentence: Heavy traffic will {degrade} the air quality in the valley.
translation: Интенсивное движение ухудшит качество воздуха в долине.

definition: calm controlled behaviour, or a limit placed on something
sentence: The police showed great {restraint} when the crowd threw bottles.
translation: Полиция проявила большую сдержанность, когда толпа бросала бутылки.

definition: a handle that you turn to make a machine work, or a strange person
sentence: Turn the {crank} to lower the bucket into the well.
translation: Поверни рукоятку, чтобы опустить ведро в колодец.

definition: to provide someone with things to wear, or to dress them
sentence: It costs a lot to feed and {clothe} four growing children.
translation: Кормить и одевать четверых растущих детей стоит немалых денег.

definition: to invent a plan, system or machine using careful thought
sentence: The teacher managed to {devise} a game that made grammar fun.
translation: Учительнице удалось придумать игру, сделавшую грамматику весёлой.

definition: kitchen equipment on which you cook food, or a heater that burns wood
sentence: Leave the soup on the {stove} until it boils.
translation: Оставь суп на плите, пока он не закипит.

definition: a person who supports socialist political ideas
sentence: The {leftist} promised higher taxes on the rich.
translation: Левый политик пообещал повысить налоги для богатых.

definition: very careful, so that nothing bad happens
sentence: Be {cautious} on the stairs, they are wet.
translation: Осторожнее на лестнице, она мокрая.

definition: in a way that works well without wasting time or energy
sentence: The new system handles orders far more {efficiently} than before.
translation: Новая система обрабатывает заказы намного эффективнее, чем раньше.

definition: words or actions that give someone hope and confidence
sentence: A little {encouragement} from the teacher changed his attitude to maths.
translation: Немного поддержки от учителя изменило его отношение к математике.

definition: not able to cause harm
sentence: The snake looks frightening but is completely {harmless}.
translation: Змея выглядит пугающе, но совершенно безобидна.

definition: believing that something good will happen
sentence: She is {hopeful} that the test results will be clear.
translation: Она надеется, что результаты анализов будут чистыми.

definition: the practice of keeping yourself and your surroundings clean to stay healthy
sentence: Good {hygiene} in the kitchen prevents most food poisoning.
translation: Хорошая гигиена на кухне предотвращает большинство пищевых отравлений.

definition: existing only in the mind, not real
sentence: The little boy has an {imaginary} friend called Max.
translation: У маленького мальчика есть воображаемый друг по имени Макс.

definition: not always behaving or performing in the same way, or not matching
sentence: The team has been {inconsistent}, brilliant one week and terrible the next.
translation: Команда играет нестабильно: одну неделю блестяще, другую ужасно.

definition: a school for very young children before they start primary school
sentence: Our daughter starts {kindergarten} in September.
translation: Наша дочь идёт в детский сад в сентябре.

definition: in a way that makes a lot of noise
sentence: The baby cried {loudly} through the whole flight.
translation: Малыш громко плакал весь полёт.

definition: a person whose job is to repair machines, especially cars
sentence: The {mechanic} said the brakes need replacing before winter.
translation: Механик сказал, что тормоза нужно заменить до зимы.

definition: in or from the north-west of a place
sentence: The {northwestern} coast gets the most rain in the country.
translation: На северо-западном побережье выпадает больше всего дождей в стране.

definition: cruel and unfair treatment of people by those in power
sentence: Thousands fled the country to escape political {oppression}.
translation: Тысячи бежали из страны, спасаясь от политического гнёта.

definition: showing love for and pride in your country
sentence: The crowd sang {patriotic} songs as the flag was raised.
translation: Толпа пела патриотические песни, пока поднимали флаг.

definition: likely to happen or be true
sentence: It is {probable} that the match will be moved because of the snow.
translation: Вероятно, матч перенесут из-за снега.

definition: a period of testing a person instead of prison, or when starting a job
sentence: The judge gave him a year on {probation} instead of jail.
translation: Судья назначил ему год условно вместо тюрьмы.

definition: a man who speaks for an organisation or group
sentence: A police {spokesman} said the road would reopen by noon.
translation: Представитель полиции сообщил, что дорогу откроют к полудню.

definition: based on personal feelings and opinions rather than facts
sentence: Taste in music is {subjective}; there is no right answer.
translation: Музыкальные вкусы субъективны, правильного ответа нет.

definition: causing severe shock and lasting emotional pain
sentence: Losing the house in the fire was {traumatic} for the whole family.
translation: Потеря дома при пожаре стала травмой для всей семьи.

definition: an angry argument or fight between people or groups
sentence: The meeting ended in a {confrontation} between the two managers.
translation: Встреча закончилась стычкой между двумя менеджерами.

definition: money offered as a reward for catching or killing someone, or a large generous amount
sentence: A {bounty} of ten thousand dollars was offered for the escaped prisoner.
translation: За беглого заключённого назначили награду в десять тысяч долларов.

definition: the fact of something or someone no longer being seen or found
sentence: Police are investigating the {disappearance} of a young hiker.
translation: Полиция расследует исчезновение молодого туриста.

definition: a person you love, or a kind friendly person
sentence: They were childhood {sweethearts} and married at twenty.
translation: Они были влюблены с детства и поженились в двадцать.

definition: a covering of false hair worn on the head
sentence: The actor wore a grey {wig} to play the old king.
translation: Актёр надел седой парик, чтобы сыграть старого короля.

definition: a thin flat round cake made from flour, milk and eggs, cooked in a pan
sentence: Dad makes a {pancake} for each of us on Sunday mornings.
translation: По воскресеньям папа печёт каждому из нас по блину.

definition: a talk on a religious or moral subject, usually given in church
sentence: The priest's {sermon} was about kindness to strangers.
translation: Проповедь священника была о доброте к незнакомцам.

definition: a statement that something is true, made firmly but without proof
sentence: His {assertion} that the bridge was safe turned out to be wrong.
translation: Его утверждение, что мост безопасен, оказалось ошибочным.

definition: the act of moving people away from a dangerous place
sentence: The {evacuation} of the village took less than an hour.
translation: Эвакуация деревни заняла меньше часа.

definition: the complete set of genes of a living thing
sentence: Scientists have mapped the whole {genome} of the rice plant.
translation: Учёные расшифровали весь геном риса.

definition: a formal written statement charging someone with a crime
sentence: The court issued an {indictment} against the former mayor.
translation: Суд предъявил обвинение бывшему мэру.

definition: to smell very bad
sentence: The fish will {stink} if you leave it out of the fridge.
translation: Рыба провоняет, если оставить её вне холодильника.

definition: a separate section of a train, bag or container
sentence: We had the train {compartment} to ourselves all the way to Rome.
translation: Купе в поезде было в нашем распоряжении всю дорогу до Рима.

definition: the level of quality or ability of a person or thing
sentence: Players of this {calibre} rarely join a small club.
translation: Игроки такого уровня редко идут в маленький клуб.

definition: one of the smaller parts into which something is divided
sentence: The chapter has a {subdivision} on each type of cloud.
translation: В главе есть подраздел о каждом типе облаков.

definition: a small round sweet cake or bread roll, or hair tied in a round shape
sentence: He bought a hot {bun} with raisins from the bakery.
translation: Он купил в пекарне горячую булочку с изюмом.

definition: a ruler who has complete power and uses it unfairly
sentence: The {dictator} banned all newspapers that criticised him.
translation: Диктатор запретил все газеты, которые его критиковали.

definition: a Jewish religious leader and teacher
sentence: The {rabbi} led the prayers at the synagogue on Friday evening.
translation: Раввин вёл молитвы в синагоге в пятницу вечером.

definition: a person whose job is to serve or help people in a public place
sentence: The parking {attendant} showed us where to leave the car.
translation: Служащий парковки показал нам, где оставить машину.

definition: a hole in a tooth, or an empty space inside something solid
sentence: The dentist found a small {cavity} in one of my back teeth.
translation: Стоматолог нашёл небольшую дырку в одном из моих задних зубов.

definition: to say that the opposite of what someone said is true
sentence: The new evidence seems to {contradict} the witness's story.
translation: Новые улики, похоже, противоречат показаниям свидетеля.

definition: a model of a person, a copy of something, or a stupid person
sentence: The shop {dummy} in the window wore the new winter coat.
translation: Манекен в витрине магазина был в новом зимнем пальто.

definition: a flat part of a bicycle, car or piano that you press with your foot
sentence: Her foot slipped off the {pedal} and the bike wobbled.
translation: Её нога соскользнула с педали, и велосипед вильнул.

definition: a person you know a little but who is not a close friend
sentence: He is just an {acquaintance} from work, not a real friend.
translation: Он просто знакомый по работе, а не настоящий друг.

definition: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves that people smoke
sentence: Grandfather smoked one {cigar} every Sunday after lunch.
translation: Дедушка выкуривал одну сигару каждое воскресенье после обеда.

definition: a device that changes the voltage of an electric current
sentence: The {transformer} on the pole supplies electricity to the whole street.
translation: Трансформатор на столбе подаёт электричество на всю улицу.

definition: a qualification or experience that shows you are suitable for a job
sentence: Her main {credential} for the post is ten years in a hospital.
translation: Её главное преимущество для этой должности — десять лет работы в больнице.

definition: a member of a group of people that makes laws
sentence: Each {legislator} voted on the new budget before midnight.
translation: Каждый законодатель проголосовал за новый бюджет до полуночи.

definition: to complain in an annoying high voice, or to make a long high sound
sentence: The children began to {whine} about the long walk.
translation: Дети заныли из-за долгой прогулки.

definition: a thin piece of clothing that covers a woman's foot and leg
sentence: She found a hole in her {stocking} just before the interview.
translation: Прямо перед собеседованием она обнаружила дырку на чулке.

definition: a problem you must deal with, or a frame to jump over in a race
sentence: Finding the money is the biggest {hurdle} for the new school.
translation: Поиск денег — главное препятствие для новой школы.

definition: belonging to the people who lived in a country before others arrived
sentence: The museum shows {aboriginal} art from the desert regions.
translation: В музее представлено искусство коренных народов пустынных районов.

definition: becoming ill when you eat, touch or breathe a particular thing
sentence: My brother is {allergic} to cats and starts sneezing at once.
translation: У моего брата аллергия на кошек, он сразу начинает чихать.

definition: the equipment needed for a particular activity, especially scientific
sentence: The firefighters checked their breathing {apparatus} before entering.
translation: Пожарные проверили дыхательные аппараты, прежде чем войти.

definition: complete happiness
sentence: Lying in the sun with nothing to do was pure {bliss}.
translation: Лежать на солнце без всяких дел было чистым блаженством.

definition: relating to the human body
sentence: The job needs {bodily} strength as well as patience.
translation: Работа требует физической силы и терпения.

definition: involving two or more people working together
sentence: The report was a {collaborative} effort by three universities.
translation: Отчёт стал совместной работой трёх университетов.

definition: helpful and intended to improve something
sentence: Her {constructive} comments made the second draft much better.
translation: Её конструктивные замечания сделали второй вариант намного лучше.

definition: relating to the whole universe
sentence: Scientists study {cosmic} rays that reach Earth from distant stars.
translation: Учёные изучают космические лучи, приходящие на Землю от далёких звёзд.

definition: clear, certain and not likely to change
sentence: We need a {definite} answer by Friday.
translation: Нам нужен определённый ответ к пятнице.

definition: relating to the growth of a person, animal or thing
sentence: The child was behind in several {developmental} skills.
translation: Ребёнок отставал по нескольким навыкам развития.

definition: a place or party where people dance to pop music, or that music
sentence: The school {disco} ends at ten o'clock.
translation: Школьная дискотека заканчивается в десять.

definition: relating to the relationship between living things and their environment
sentence: The dam caused {ecological} damage along the whole river.
translation: Плотина нанесла экологический ущерб всей реке.

definition: the ability to produce children, young or crops
sentence: The {fertility} of the soil fell after years of the same crop.
translation: Плодородие почвы снизилось после многих лет одной культуры.

definition: the most important or best
sentence: She is the {foremost} expert on bees in the country.
translation: Она ведущий специалист по пчёлам в стране.

definition: not legally or officially acceptable, or not based on correct facts
sentence: The ticket is {invalid} because the date has passed.
translation: Билет недействителен, потому что дата прошла.

definition: together, with each person sharing the work or the responsibility
sentence: The two companies {jointly} own the new airport.
translation: Две компании совместно владеют новым аэропортом.

definition: weighing less than usual, or not serious or important
sentence: Take a {lightweight} jacket; it is warm but windy.
translation: Возьми лёгкую куртку, тепло, но ветрено.

definition: the chemical processes in the body that turn food into energy
sentence: Exercise speeds up your {metabolism} for several hours.
translation: Упражнения ускоряют обмен веществ на несколько часов.

definition: relating to a parent or parents
sentence: Children under twelve need {parental} permission to join.
translation: Детям до двенадцати нужно разрешение родителей, чтобы вступить.

definition: permission for a prisoner to leave prison early on condition of good behaviour
sentence: He was released on {parole} after serving half his sentence.
translation: Его досрочно освободили, когда он отбыл половину срока.

definition: existing commonly or happening often in a place or time
sentence: Heart disease is {prevalent} among men over fifty.
translation: Болезни сердца широко распространены среди мужчин старше пятидесяти.

definition: not certain to be true, good or honest
sentence: The wisdom of building on the flood plain is {questionable}.
translation: Разумность строительства на затапливаемой равнине сомнительна.

definition: the study of how people live together in society
sentence: She studied {sociology} and now works on housing policy.
translation: Она изучала социологию и теперь занимается жилищной политикой.

definition: the grip of a wheel or foot on a surface, or growing support
sentence: The tyres lost {traction} on the icy road.
translation: Шины потеряли сцепление на обледенелой дороге.

definition: a fish that lives in rivers and lakes and is eaten as food
sentence: We caught a {trout} in the stream and cooked it on the fire.
translation: Мы поймали в ручье форель и зажарили её на костре.

definition: not wanted or needed
sentence: The charity collects {unwanted} furniture and gives it to families.
translation: Благотворительная организация собирает ненужную мебель и отдаёт её семьям.

definition: how far you can see, depending on the weather, or being easy to notice
sentence: Thick fog cut {visibility} on the motorway to fifty metres.
translation: Густой туман снизил видимость на автомагистрали до пятидесяти метров.

definition: a strong drink with alcohol made from grain
sentence: He poured a small glass of {whiskey} and sat by the fire.
translation: Он налил маленький стакан виски и сел у камина.

definition: to remember and honour an important person or event with a ceremony
sentence: A stone was placed to {commemorate} the miners who died.
translation: Камень установили в память о погибших шахтёрах.

definition: an underground pipe that carries waste water away from buildings
sentence: Heavy rain caused the {sewer} to overflow into the street.
translation: Сильный дождь вызвал переполнение канализации, и она вылилась на улицу.

definition: a big or difficult task, or a formal promise
sentence: Building the tunnel under the sea was a huge {undertaking}.
translation: Строительство туннеля под морем было огромным предприятием.

definition: paper with a pattern used to cover the walls of a room
sentence: The old {wallpaper} in the bedroom had faded roses on it.
translation: На старых обоях в спальне были выцветшие розы.

definition: to scatter small drops or pieces of something over a surface
sentence: {Sprinkle} a little sugar over the strawberries.
translation: Посыпь клубнику немного сахаром.

definition: thick oil or soft fat used on machines or left by cooking
sentence: The pan was covered in {grease} after frying the bacon.
translation: После жарки бекона сковорода была покрыта жиром.

definition: a small reptile with four legs and a long tail
sentence: A green {lizard} sat on the warm stone wall.
translation: Зелёная ящерица сидела на тёплой каменной стене.

definition: to crush food until it is soft and smooth
sentence: {Mash} the potatoes with butter and a little milk.
translation: Разомни картошку с маслом и небольшим количеством молока.

definition: to give the main points of something in a short form
sentence: Can you {summarize} the report in one paragraph?
translation: Можешь изложить отчёт в одном абзаце?

definition: money given by a company to support an event or person, usually for advertising
sentence: The team lost its {sponsorship} after the scandal.
translation: После скандала команда лишилась спонсорской поддержки.

definition: a surface or material on which something lives, grows or is built
sentence: The moss needs a damp {substrate} such as bark or stone.
translation: Мху нужна влажная основа, например кора или камень.

definition: to give someone information so they understand something better
sentence: Could you {enlighten} me about how the new system works?
translation: Не мог бы ты объяснить мне, как работает новая система?

definition: a comparison between two things that shows how they are similar
sentence: The teacher used the {analogy} of a river to explain electricity.
translation: Учитель объяснил электричество через сравнение с рекой.

definition: a printed ticket that can be used instead of money to pay for something
sentence: The hotel gave us a {voucher} for a free breakfast.
translation: Отель дал нам ваучер на бесплатный завтрак.

definition: a group of military aircraft, ships or soldiers
sentence: The {squadron} of fighter planes flew over the parade.
translation: Эскадрилья истребителей пролетела над парадом.

definition: the thick soft part of a bed that you lie on
sentence: The old {mattress} was so soft that my back hurt every morning.
translation: Старый матрас был таким мягким, что у меня каждое утро болела спина.

definition: to get back something that was yours, or to make land usable again
sentence: You can {reclaim} the tax at the airport before you fly home.
translation: Вы можете вернуть налог в аэропорту перед вылетом домой.

definition: a clear strong drink with alcohol and a taste of berries
sentence: She ordered a {gin} and tonic with a slice of lime.
translation: Она заказала джин с тоником и долькой лайма.

definition: a covered passage with shops, or a place with machines for playing games
sentence: The children spent all their coins in the games {arcade}.
translation: Дети потратили все монеты в зале игровых автоматов.

definition: a tool with a sharp blade used to remove hair from the skin
sentence: He cut his chin with a new {razor} this morning.
translation: Утром он порезал подбородок новой бритвой.

definition: to describe an event in detail, or to count votes again
sentence: The old sailor loved to {recount} his adventures at sea.
translation: Старый моряк любил рассказывать о своих приключениях в море.

definition: to prevent or slow down a process or action
sentence: High interest rates {inhibit} the growth of small businesses.
translation: Высокие процентные ставки сдерживают рост малого бизнеса.

definition: a hollow mark in a hard surface made by hitting it
sentence: There is a {dent} in the car door where the trolley hit it.
translation: На двери машины вмятина там, где в неё врезалась тележка.

definition: a person who fights by holding and throwing an opponent as a sport
sentence: The {wrestler} lifted his opponent and threw him to the mat.
translation: Борец поднял соперника и бросил его на мат.

definition: a mathematical statement that can be proved to be true
sentence: Every student has to learn Pythagoras' {theorem}.
translation: Каждый ученик должен выучить теорему Пифагора.

definition: a chemical made by the body or taken as a drug, sometimes to build muscle
sentence: The athlete was banned for two years for using a {steroid}.
translation: Спортсмена дисквалифицировали на два года за применение стероидов.

definition: a white or grey bird often used as a symbol of peace
sentence: A white {dove} was released at the end of the ceremony.
translation: В конце церемонии выпустили белого голубя.

definition: a person who knows a lot about and loves a particular subject, especially computers
sentence: My sister is a science {geek} who watches space videos all weekend.
translation: Моя сестра помешана на науке и всё выходные смотрит видео о космосе.

definition: lack of respect, or rude behaviour towards someone
sentence: Arriving late shows {disrespect} to the people who wait for you.
translation: Опаздывать — значит проявлять неуважение к тем, кто вас ждёт.

definition: an enemy, used in formal or literary language
sentence: The two old {foes} shook hands after thirty years.
translation: Два старых врага пожали друг другу руки спустя тридцать лет.

definition: a two-piece swimming suit worn by women
sentence: She bought a blue {bikini} for the holiday in Greece.
translation: Она купила голубое бикини для отпуска в Греции.

definition: to look quickly or secretly at something
sentence: The children tried to {peek} at the presents before Christmas.
translation: Дети пытались тайком заглянуть в подарки до Рождества.

definition: to be connected so that one thing changes when the other does
sentence: Hours of sleep {correlate} closely with marks in the exam.
translation: Количество часов сна тесно связано с оценками на экзамене.

definition: a person who organises concerts or sports events, or who supports an idea
sentence: The {promoter} booked the stadium for three nights in July.
translation: Промоутер забронировал стадион на три вечера в июле.

definition: to express an idea or plan in clear words
sentence: Give me a minute to {formulate} my answer.
translation: Дай мне минуту, чтобы сформулировать ответ.

definition: an object in space that looks like a bright star with a long tail
sentence: The {comet} will be visible in the night sky for a week.
translation: Комета будет видна в ночном небе в течение недели.

definition: a person who swims
sentence: The young {swimmer} broke the national record by a second.
translation: Юная пловчиха побила национальный рекорд на секунду.

definition: a strong underground shelter with thick walls, used in war
sentence: The family hid in the {bunker} until the bombing stopped.
translation: Семья пряталась в бункере, пока не прекратилась бомбёжка.

definition: to bend your knees and sit on your heels close to the ground
sentence: You have to {squat} to reach the bottom shelf.
translation: Чтобы достать до нижней полки, нужно присесть на корточки.

definition: a person who writes opinions about books, films or products
sentence: Every {reviewer} praised the acting but hated the ending.
translation: Все критики хвалили игру актёров, но ругали концовку.

definition: a fight with swords or guns between two people, especially in the past
sentence: The two officers fought a {duel} at dawn over an insult.
translation: Два офицера дрались на дуэли на рассвете из-за оскорбления.

definition: to wake up, or to make someone start to feel or notice something
sentence: The trip to Rome helped {awaken} her interest in history.
translation: Поездка в Рим пробудила в ней интерес к истории.

definition: a period of work experience, often unpaid, for a student or new graduate
sentence: She did a summer {internship} at a law firm in Boston.
translation: Летом она проходила стажировку в юридической фирме в Бостоне.

definition: a word that names a person, place, thing or idea
sentence: In 'The dog sleeps', the {noun} is 'dog'.
translation: В предложении «The dog sleeps» существительное — «dog».

definition: deliberate damage to equipment or plans to stop them working
sentence: The power cut was an act of {sabotage}, not an accident.
translation: Отключение электричества было актом саботажа, а не случайностью.

definition: existing in large amounts, more than enough
sentence: Fresh fish is {abundant} and cheap in this town.
translation: Свежей рыбы в этом городе полно, и она дешёвая.

definition: measured or judged by comparing with something else
sentence: After years of war, the country now enjoys {comparative} peace.
translation: После многих лет войны страна теперь живёт в относительном мире.

definition: the state of continuing without interruption or change
sentence: The new coach promised {continuity} rather than big changes.
translation: Новый тренер пообещал преемственность, а не большие перемены.

definition: able to be believed or trusted
sentence: The witness gave a {credible} account of the accident.
translation: Свидетель дал правдоподобное описание аварии.

definition: very nice and giving great pleasure
sentence: We spent a {delightful} afternoon in the old town.
translation: Мы провели восхитительный день в старом городе.

definition: the system of pipes or channels that carries water away
sentence: Poor {drainage} turns the football pitch into a lake every winter.
translation: Из-за плохого дренажа футбольное поле каждую зиму превращается в озеро.

definition: the feeling of shame or shyness in front of others, or its cause
sentence: To her {embarrassment}, she forgot the name of her own boss.
translation: К своему смущению, она забыла имя собственного начальника.

definition: the quality of treating everyone equally and honestly
sentence: In {fairness}, he did warn us that the road might be closed.
translation: Справедливости ради, он предупреждал нас, что дорога может быть закрыта.

definition: a very hard grey stone that makes sparks when struck
sentence: Early people used {flint} to make knives and start fires.
translation: Древние люди использовали кремень для ножей и разведения огня.

definition: made of flowers or decorated with pictures of flowers
sentence: She wore a {floral} dress with red poppies on it.
translation: На ней было платье с цветочным узором из красных маков.

definition: in the most basic and important way
sentence: The two plans are {fundamentally} different in who pays.
translation: Два плана принципиально различаются тем, кто платит.

definition: the courage to do something hard, or the organs inside the stomach
sentence: It took real {guts} to tell the boss he was wrong.
translation: Нужна была настоящая смелость, чтобы сказать начальнику, что он не прав.

definition: based on a set of strong political or social beliefs
sentence: The split in the party was {ideological}, not personal.
translation: Раскол в партии был идеологическим, а не личным.

definition: not enough
sentence: There was {insufficient} evidence to charge the suspect.
translation: Улик было недостаточно, чтобы предъявить подозреваемому обвинение.

definition: a soft sweet food made from fruit juice and sugar that shakes when moved
sentence: The children had ice cream and strawberry {jelly} at the party.
translation: На празднике дети ели мороженое и клубничное желе.

definition: using the basic meaning of a word, not a figurative one
sentence: The {literal} meaning of the phrase is 'to break a leg'.
translation: Буквальное значение фразы — «сломать ногу».

definition: relating to the moon
sentence: The first {lunar} landing took place in 1969.
translation: Первая высадка на Луну состоялась в 1969 году.

definition: relating to a mother, or typical of a kind mother
sentence: My {maternal} grandmother came from a village in Poland.
translation: Моя бабушка по материнской линии была родом из деревни в Польше.

definition: the children or young of a person or animal
sentence: The bird returns each year to feed its {offspring} in the same nest.
translation: Птица каждый год возвращается кормить потомство в том же гнезде.

definition: shocking and completely unacceptable
sentence: Charging ten euros for a coffee is {outrageous}.
translation: Брать десять евро за кофе — это возмутительно.

definition: a game played on horses in which players hit a ball with long wooden sticks
sentence: The prince plays {polo} every summer at the club.
translation: Принц каждое лето играет в поло в клубе.

definition: a place or book where official records are kept
sentence: Every birth is recorded in the town {registry}.
translation: Каждое рождение регистрируется в городском реестре.

definition: in a way that is surprising or worth noticing
sentence: The old car is {remarkably} reliable for its age.
translation: Старая машина удивительно надёжна для своего возраста.

definition: the quality of being simple and easy to understand or do
sentence: The beauty of the design lies in its {simplicity}.
translation: Красота дизайна в его простоте.

definition: in a quiet and gentle way
sentence: She spoke {softly} so as not to wake the baby.
translation: Она говорила тихо, чтобы не разбудить ребёнка.

definition: a machine for playing music with two speakers
sentence: He turned up the {stereo} and the whole street heard the song.
translation: Он включил стереосистему погромче, и песню услышала вся улица.

definition: the ability to continue over a long time without harming the environment
sentence: The company reports on its {sustainability} every year.
translation: Компания ежегодно отчитывается о своей экологической устойчивости.

definition: relating to the study of religion and God
sentence: The two churches split over a {theological} argument.
translation: Две церкви разделились из-за богословского спора.

definition: working secretly, especially as a police officer, to get information
sentence: An {undercover} officer joined the gang for six months.
translation: Полицейский под прикрытием провёл в банде шесть месяцев.

definition: plants in general, especially those growing in a particular area
sentence: Thick {vegetation} hid the entrance to the cave.
translation: Густая растительность скрывала вход в пещеру.

definition: a soft thick cloth with a smooth surface on one side
sentence: The curtains were made of deep red {velvet}.
translation: Шторы были из тёмно-красного бархата.

definition: to make a series of short hard sounds, or to make someone nervous
sentence: The wind made the windows {rattle} all night.
translation: Ветер всю ночь стучал оконными рамами.

definition: a sudden painful tightening of a muscle
sentence: He got a {cramp} in his leg halfway through the race.
translation: На середине забега у него свело ногу.

definition: to love and care for something or someone very much
sentence: I {cherish} the letters my grandmother wrote to me.
translation: Я дорожу письмами, которые писала мне бабушка.

definition: to move suddenly and quickly
sentence: A mouse began to {dart} across the kitchen floor.
translation: Мышь метнулась через кухонный пол.

definition: a tree with long thin branches that hang down, often growing near water
sentence: A {willow} leaned over the river and touched the water.
translation: Ива склонилась над рекой и касалась воды.

definition: a beautiful view over a wide area
sentence: From the top there is a {vista} of the whole valley.
translation: С вершины открывается вид на всю долину.

definition: to treat used materials so they can be used again
sentence: We {recycle} all our glass and paper at the centre on Saturdays.
translation: По субботам мы сдаём всё стекло и бумагу на переработку.

definition: to clap your hands to show you enjoyed something, or to praise a decision
sentence: The audience stood to {applaud} the young pianist.
translation: Зрители встали, чтобы аплодировать юному пианисту.

definition: a small animal that lives under the ground, or a dark spot on the skin
sentence: A {mole} has dug up half the lawn in one night.
translation: Крот за одну ночь перерыл половину газона.

definition: to put furniture in a room or building, or to supply something
sentence: It will cost a lot to {furnish} the whole flat from nothing.
translation: Обставить всю квартиру с нуля будет дорого.

definition: a large black and white animal like a bear that lives in China
sentence: The {panda} ate bamboo for six hours without stopping.
translation: Панда шесть часов без перерыва ела бамбук.

definition: a huge mass of ice that moves very slowly down a mountain
sentence: The {glacier} has shrunk by a kilometre in fifty years.
translation: За пятьдесят лет ледник сократился на километр.

definition: a standard used to measure or judge other things
sentence: The old record is the {benchmark} every runner wants to beat.
translation: Старый рекорд — ориентир, который хочет побить каждый бегун.

definition: a large animal like a monkey without a tail, such as a gorilla
sentence: The {ape} used a stick to pull the fruit from the tree.
translation: Обезьяна палкой стянула фрукт с дерева.

definition: one of the twelve men chosen by Jesus to spread his teaching
sentence: The church is named after the {apostle} Peter.
translation: Церковь названа в честь апостола Петра.

definition: a person with extreme political or religious views who may use violence
sentence: Police arrested the {extremist} before the planned attack.
translation: Полиция арестовала экстремиста до запланированного нападения.

definition: a person or company that is owed money
sentence: The company could not pay a single {creditor} by the end of the year.
translation: К концу года компания не могла заплатить ни одному кредитору.

definition: the top of a hill or wave, or the sign of a family or club
sentence: We reached the {crest} of the hill and saw the sea.
translation: Мы достигли гребня холма и увидели море.

definition: to change something slightly to improve it
sentence: We just need to {tweak} the colours and the poster is ready.
translation: Нам нужно лишь немного подправить цвета, и плакат готов.

definition: to prove or officially confirm that something is true or acceptable
sentence: The results of the study will {validate} years of research.
translation: Результаты исследования подтвердят многолетнюю работу.

definition: a building where monks live and pray
sentence: The {monastery} on the island has stood for a thousand years.
translation: Монастырь на острове стоит уже тысячу лет.

definition: to relate to or be connected with something
sentence: These rules {pertain} only to students who live on campus.
translation: Эти правила касаются только студентов, живущих в кампусе.

definition: a picture or figure that represents a person on a screen or in a game
sentence: She chose a cat as her {avatar} in the chat app.
translation: В чате она выбрала аватаром кошку.

definition: a short part taken from a book, film or piece of music
sentence: The magazine printed an {excerpt} from her new novel.
translation: Журнал напечатал отрывок из её нового романа.

definition: to raise a hand to your head as a sign of respect
sentence: The soldiers {salute} the flag every morning at dawn.
translation: Солдаты каждое утро на рассвете отдают честь флагу.

definition: a player who plays near the side of the field in football or hockey
sentence: The {winger} ran past two defenders and crossed the ball.
translation: Фланговый игрок обошёл двух защитников и сделал навес.

definition: to make something less harmful or serious
sentence: Planting trees can {mitigate} the effects of floods.
translation: Посадка деревьев может смягчить последствия наводнений.

definition: to say something that makes a worried person feel calm
sentence: The nurse {reassured} me that the test was routine.
translation: Медсестра успокоила меня, сказав, что анализ обычный.

definition: a bar at the front or back of a car that protects it
sentence: The {bumper} fell off when he backed into the wall.
translation: Бампер отвалился, когда он въехал задом в стену.

definition: a soft cloth or pad that a baby wears between its legs
sentence: Change the {diaper} before you put the baby to bed.
translation: Поменяй подгузник, прежде чем укладывать малыша спать.

definition: a player who gets goals or points, or a person who keeps count of them
sentence: The top {scorer} in the league got thirty goals this season.
translation: Лучший бомбардир лиги забил тридцать голов в этом сезоне.

definition: to give something a new name
sentence: The city decided to {rename} the street after the poet.
translation: Город решил переименовать улицу в честь поэта.

definition: to go up or climb
sentence: The path begins to {ascend} steeply after the bridge.
translation: После моста тропа начинает круто подниматься.

definition: a man who serves food and drink at tables in a restaurant
sentence: The {waiter} brought the wrong dish twice.
translation: Официант дважды принёс не то блюдо.

definition: a situation in which life is difficult, especially because of lack of money
sentence: Many families faced real {hardship} when the factory closed.
translation: Многие семьи столкнулись с настоящими трудностями, когда закрылся завод.

definition: a long piece of clothing that hangs free, worn at home or at a ceremony
sentence: The judge put on her black {robe} before entering the court.
translation: Судья надела чёрную мантию перед входом в зал суда.

definition: to spread out in different directions, or to make a crowd do this
sentence: The police used water to {disperse} the crowd.
translation: Полиция применила воду, чтобы разогнать толпу.

definition: an area of land where grapes are grown for making wine
sentence: The family has owned the {vineyard} for five generations.
translation: Виноградник принадлежит семье уже пять поколений.

definition: a dark underground prison, especially in a castle
sentence: The prisoners were kept in a {dungeon} beneath the castle.
translation: Узников держали в подземелье под замком.

definition: a place that opens late at night where people drink and dance
sentence: The {nightclub} on the corner is open until four in the morning.
translation: Ночной клуб на углу открыт до четырёх утра.

definition: to see or look at something, used in old or literary language
sentence: Few people have ever {beheld} such a sight.
translation: Мало кто когда-либо видел такое зрелище.

definition: behaviour that deliberately causes pain to people or animals
sentence: He was fined for {cruelty} to the dogs he kept in the yard.
translation: Его оштрафовали за жестокое обращение с собаками, которых он держал во дворе.

definition: a serious illness of the brain that makes people forget and confuses them
sentence: My grandmother has {dementia} and no longer knows my name.
translation: У моей бабушки деменция, и она больше не помнит моего имени.

definition: a woman of very high rank, or the wife of a duke
sentence: The {duchess} opened the new hospital wing.
translation: Герцогиня открыла новое крыло больницы.

definition: a situation in which a type of animal or plant stops existing
sentence: Hunting drove the great auk to {extinction} in 1844.
translation: Охота привела к вымиранию бескрылой гагарки в 1844 году.

definition: the study of rocks and how the Earth was formed
sentence: She studied {geology} and now works for a mining company.
translation: Она изучала геологию и теперь работает в горнодобывающей компании.

definition: extremely pleasant, or relating to heaven or the sky
sentence: The cake tasted {heavenly}, light and full of cream.
translation: Торт был божественным, лёгким и полным крема.

definition: extremely bad and shocking
sentence: The crash was {horrific}, but everyone survived.
translation: Авария была ужасной, но все выжили.

definition: the coloured part of the eye, or a plant with tall purple or yellow flowers
sentence: The {iris} of his left eye is green and the right one is brown.
translation: Радужка его левого глаза зелёная, а правого карего цвета.

definition: a particular way of thinking shared by a person or group
sentence: A winning {mentality} matters as much as talent in this sport.
translation: В этом спорте настрой на победу важен не меньше таланта.

definition: relating to the nerves or the brain
sentence: The scientists mapped the {neural} paths used in reading.
translation: Учёные картировали нервные пути, задействованные при чтении.

definition: coming after eighteen others in a series
sentence: The railway reached the town in the {nineteenth} century.
translation: Железная дорога пришла в город в девятнадцатом веке.

definition: a gas with no colour or smell that makes up most of the air
sentence: Plants take {nitrogen} from the soil to grow.
translation: Растения берут азот из почвы, чтобы расти.

definition: extremely great or impressive
sentence: The band's new album has been a {phenomenal} success.
translation: Новый альбом группы имел феноменальный успех.

definition: relating to photographs, or extremely exact like a photograph
sentence: She has a {photographic} memory for faces.
translation: У неё фотографическая память на лица.

definition: happening in a way that you expect
sentence: The ending of the film was {predictable} but still enjoyable.
translation: Концовка фильма была предсказуемой, но всё равно приятной.

definition: in a way that relates to a job, or in a skilled careful way
sentence: He has played the piano {professionally} for twenty years.
translation: Он профессионально играет на пианино уже двадцать лет.

definition: not heterosexual, or strange and unusual, in older use
sentence: The festival celebrates {queer} artists from across the region.
translation: Фестиваль чествует квир-художников со всего региона.

definition: the process of treating used materials so they can be used again
sentence: Put the bottles in the {recycling} bin, not the rubbish.
translation: Клади бутылки в контейнер для переработки, а не в мусор.

definition: the return of a dead person to life, or the revival of something
sentence: The band's {resurrection} after ten years surprised everyone.
translation: Возрождение группы спустя десять лет удивило всех.

definition: relating to space and the position and size of things in it
sentence: Good {spatial} skills help you park a car in a tight space.
translation: Хорошее пространственное мышление помогает припарковать машину в узком месте.

definition: used of steel that does not rust
sentence: The kitchen has {stainless} steel sinks that never go brown.
translation: На кухне раковины из нержавеющей стали, которые никогда не ржавеют.

definition: decided or required by law
sentence: Every worker has a {statutory} right to paid holiday.
translation: Каждый работник имеет установленное законом право на оплачиваемый отпуск.

definition: extremely good, or relating to stars
sentence: She gave a {stellar} performance and won the award.
translation: Она выступила блестяще и получила награду.

definition: refusing to change your mind even when you should
sentence: He's too {stubborn} to ask for directions.
translation: Он слишком упрямый, чтобы спросить дорогу.

definition: a thick sweet liquid made from sugar and water or fruit juice
sentence: Pour some maple {syrup} over the pancakes.
translation: Полей блины кленовым сиропом.

definition: firmly and closely, with no space or looseness
sentence: Hold the rope {tightly} and do not let go.
translation: Держи верёвку крепко и не отпускай.

definition: short grass and the soil under it, or an area someone controls
sentence: The new {turf} on the pitch needs water every evening.
translation: Новый дёрн на поле нужно поливать каждый вечер.

definition: in a way that is not normal, or more than usual
sentence: It is {unusually} warm for October this week.
translation: На этой неделе необычно тепло для октября.

definition: to make something bigger
sentence: We want to {enlarge} the kitchen by knocking down a wall.
translation: Мы хотим расширить кухню, снеся стену.

definition: to push someone roughly, or to work hard and fast to get something
sentence: Guards began to {hustle} the singer through the crowd.
translation: Охранники стали проталкивать певицу сквозь толпу.

definition: to make something exist or happen again in a new form
sentence: The museum has tried to {recreate} a street from 1900.
translation: Музей попытался воссоздать улицу 1900 года.

definition: the forehead, or the line of hair above the eye
sentence: He wiped the sweat from his {brow} and kept digging.
translation: Он вытер пот со лба и продолжил копать.

definition: to repair and improve an old building
sentence: They plan to {renovate} the old barn and live in it.
translation: Они планируют отремонтировать старый амбар и жить в нём.

definition: a coloured substance in a stick that women put on their lips
sentence: She put on red {lipstick} before the party.
translation: Перед вечеринкой она накрасила губы красной помадой.

definition: an attempt to do something, especially something new or difficult
sentence: The bridge was the greatest engineering {endeavor} of its time.
translation: Мост был величайшим инженерным начинанием своего времени.

definition: a holy song or poem, especially one from the Bible
sentence: The choir sang a {psalm} at the funeral.
translation: На похоронах хор спел псалом.

definition: a wide flat area of grassland in North America
sentence: Farms now cover most of the {prairie} where buffalo once ran.
translation: Фермы теперь покрывают большую часть прерии, где когда-то бегали бизоны.

definition: relating to or forming part of a pair of long clothes worn on the legs
sentence: He keeps his keys in his left {trouser} pocket.
translation: Он держит ключи в левом кармане брюк.

definition: an extra benefit you get from your job, such as a car or free meals
sentence: A free gym pass is one of the {perks} of working here.
translation: Бесплатный абонемент в спортзал — один из бонусов работы здесь.

definition: the foot of an animal such as a cat, dog or bear
sentence: The dog lifted its {paw} and waited for a treat.
translation: Собака подняла лапу и ждала угощения.

definition: extra soldiers or police sent to help, or something that makes a structure stronger
sentence: The police called for {reinforcement} when the crowd grew.
translation: Полиция вызвала подкрепление, когда толпа выросла.

definition: an improvement that makes something better or more valuable
sentence: The new lens is a big {enhancement} to the camera.
translation: Новый объектив — значительное улучшение для камеры.

definition: a person who works in a library
sentence: The {librarian} helped me find books about Roman roads.
translation: Библиотекарь помогла мне найти книги о римских дорогах.

definition: a very strong wind
sentence: The {gale} tore branches from the trees along the coast.
translation: Штормовой ветер срывал ветки с деревьев вдоль побережья.

definition: to move up and down or from side to side, often making a noise
sentence: The flag began to {flap} wildly as the storm came closer.
translation: Флаг яростно захлопал на ветру, когда буря приблизилась.

definition: to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable
sentence: On holiday I {indulge} in a big breakfast every morning.
translation: В отпуске я каждое утро позволяю себе плотный завтрак.

definition: to make something dirty or dangerous by adding something bad to it
sentence: Chemicals from the factory may {contaminate} the river.
translation: Химикаты с завода могут загрязнить реку.

definition: an exact copy of something, especially a work of art or a historic object
sentence: The museum shop sells a small {replica} of the famous statue.
translation: В музейном магазине продаётся маленькая копия знаменитой статуи.

definition: to happen or develop gradually, or to open something that was folded
sentence: We watched the drama {unfold} on the news all evening.
translation: Мы весь вечер следили по новостям за тем, как разворачивается драма.

definition: to make something work as well as possible
sentence: The engineers worked for months to {optimize} the engine for fuel use.
translation: Инженеры месяцами работали над оптимизацией расхода топлива двигателем.

definition: not working or being used, doing nothing
sentence: The machine has been {idle} since the factory closed.
translation: Станок простаивает с тех пор, как закрыли завод.

definition: a metal made by mixing two or more metals
sentence: Bronze is an {alloy} of copper and tin.
translation: Бронза — сплав меди и олова.

definition: a light inside a glass or paper case that can be carried or hung
sentence: He lit a {lantern} and went out to check on the horses.
translation: Он зажёг фонарь и вышел проверить лошадей.

definition: a person who often has a cigarette
sentence: As a heavy {smoker}, he coughed every morning.
translation: Как заядлый курильщик, он кашлял каждое утро.

definition: a flat sea animal in a shell, often eaten raw, that may hold a pearl
sentence: He opened an {oyster} and found a tiny pearl inside.
translation: Он открыл устрицу и нашёл внутри крошечную жемчужину.

definition: a bar or handle that you pull or push to make a machine work
sentence: Pull the {lever} to open the gate.
translation: Потяни рычаг, чтобы открыть ворота.

definition: to take a sudden loud breath because of surprise, pain or lack of air
sentence: The crowd began to {gasp} as the climber slipped.
translation: Толпа ахнула, когда альпинист поскользнулся.

definition: a pile of earth or stones, or a small hill
sentence: The dog buried the bone under a {mound} of earth.
translation: Собака закопала кость под холмиком земли.

definition: to damage something or make it weaker
sentence: Loud music can {impair} your hearing over time.
translation: Громкая музыка со временем может ослабить слух.

definition: a dry hard piece of food like a flat bread, often served with cheese
sentence: She put a slice of cheese on a {cracker} and ate it.
translation: Она положила на крекер ломтик сыра и съела.

definition: a long piece of writing on one subject, done for a university degree
sentence: She wrote her {dissertation} on the history of the city's bridges.
translation: Она написала диссертацию об истории городских мостов.

definition: connected with punishing people who break rules
sentence: The player faces {disciplinary} action for kicking an opponent.
translation: Игроку грозит дисциплинарное взыскание за удар соперника.

definition: the fact of being allowed to do or receive something
sentence: Check your {eligibility} for the grant before you apply.
translation: Проверьте, имеете ли вы право на грант, прежде чем подавать заявку.

definition: having a limit or an end
sentence: The oil in the ground is a {finite} resource.
translation: Нефть в земле — ограниченный ресурс.

definition: the most important product, place or ship of a company or fleet
sentence: The company's new {flagship} store opened on the main street.
translation: Новый флагманский магазин компании открылся на главной улице.

definition: relating to scientific methods used to solve crimes
sentence: {Forensic} experts found a hair on the broken window.
translation: Криминалисты нашли волос на разбитом окне.

definition: happening or coming soon, or willing to give information
sentence: Tickets for the {forthcoming} concert go on sale on Monday.
translation: Билеты на предстоящий концерт поступят в продажу в понедельник.

definition: a type of sugar found in fruit and blood that gives the body energy
sentence: The nurse checked the {glucose} level in his blood.
translation: Медсестра проверила уровень глюкозы в его крови.

definition: wanting more money, food or power than you need
sentence: The {greedy} child took all the cakes and left none for the others.
translation: Жадный ребёнок забрал все пирожные и ничего не оставил другим.

definition: a circle of light shown around the head of a holy person in pictures
sentence: In the painting, the saint has a golden {halo}.
translation: На картине у святого золотой нимб.

definition: in the best possible way, if things were perfect
sentence: {Ideally}, we would leave at six, but seven is fine.
translation: В идеале мы бы выехали в шесть, но и семь подойдёт.

definition: famous for something bad
sentence: The street was {infamous} for its pickpockets.
translation: Улица была печально известна своими карманниками.

definition: making people feel hopeful and wanting to do something good
sentence: Her {inspirational} speech made half the hall cry.
translation: Её вдохновляющая речь заставила половину зала плакать.

definition: inside a body, organisation or country
sentence: The problem was handled {internally} without calling the police.
translation: Проблему решили внутри компании, не вызывая полицию.

definition: relating to the side of something, or moving sideways
sentence: The crab makes a {lateral} move across the sand.
translation: Краб движется по песку боком.

definition: lasting for the whole of a person's life
sentence: They became {lifelong} friends after one summer at camp.
translation: После одного лета в лагере они стали друзьями на всю жизнь.

definition: a white or grey rock used for building and making cement
sentence: The cathedral is built of pale {limestone} from a local quarry.
translation: Собор построен из светлого известняка из местной каменоломни.

definition: material like a net made of wire or thread with small holes
sentence: A fine {mesh} over the window keeps the mosquitoes out.
translation: Мелкая сетка на окне не пропускает комаров.

definition: believing people too easily because you have little experience
sentence: I was {naive} to think the landlord would fix it quickly.
translation: Наивно было думать, что хозяин быстро всё починит.

definition: easy to see or notice
sentence: There was a {noticeable} drop in temperature after sunset.
translation: После заката было заметное понижение температуры.

definition: the respect and admiration that a person or thing has because of success
sentence: The university's {prestige} attracts students from all over the world.
translation: Престиж университета привлекает студентов со всего мира.

definition: the degree to which something is connected with what is being discussed
sentence: I do not see the {relevance} of his age to the job.
translation: Я не вижу, какое отношение его возраст имеет к работе.

definition: from a distance, or at all, used in negative sentences
sentence: She works {remotely} from a cottage in the mountains.
translation: Она работает удалённо из домика в горах.

definition: not able to change or bend, very strict
sentence: Her diet is so {rigid} that she can't eat out.
translation: Её диета такая строгая, что она не может есть в кафе.

definition: the process of taking a small part of something to test or study the whole
sentence: Water {sampling} showed no sign of pollution in the lake.
translation: Отбор проб воды не выявил признаков загрязнения озера.

definition: a vehicle that travels in space
sentence: The {spacecraft} will take seven months to reach Mars.
translation: Космическому кораблю понадобится семь месяцев, чтобы добраться до Марса.

definition: excellent or very beautiful
sentence: We had a {splendid} view of the mountains from the balcony.
translation: С балкона открывался великолепный вид на горы.

definition: how thick something is, or the distance between its two surfaces
sentence: Cut the bread to a {thickness} of about one centimetre.
translation: Нарежь хлеб толщиной примерно в один сантиметр.

definition: not fair or sensible, or more than you would expect
sentence: It is {unreasonable} to expect an answer within the hour.
translation: Неразумно ожидать ответа в течение часа.

definition: not certain about something
sentence: I am still {unsure} whether to accept the offer.
translation: Я всё ещё не уверен, принимать ли предложение.

definition: towards a higher place or level
sentence: The path climbs {upwards} through the forest to the lake.
translation: Тропа поднимается вверх через лес к озеру.

definition: relating to the medical care of animals
sentence: She is studying at a {veterinary} college to become an animal doctor.
translation: Она учится в ветеринарном колледже, чтобы стать врачом для животных.

definition: very bright, clear and strong, easy to imagine
sentence: I still have a {vivid} memory of my first day at school.
translation: Я до сих пор ярко помню свой первый день в школе.

definition: a list of songs chosen to be played one after another
sentence: He made a {playlist} of slow songs for the long drive.
translation: Он составил плейлист из медленных песен для долгой поездки.

definition: to make it difficult for something to happen or for someone to do something
sentence: Thick snow will {hinder} the search for the missing climbers.
translation: Глубокий снег затруднит поиски пропавших альпинистов.

definition: the end of a sleeve around the wrist, or a ring locked on a prisoner
sentence: A button fell off the {cuff} of his shirt.
translation: С манжеты его рубашки оторвалась пуговица.

definition: to save something from a situation in which other things were lost or damaged
sentence: Divers tried to {salvage} the gold from the sunken ship.
translation: Водолазы пытались поднять золото с затонувшего корабля.

definition: a connection with a political party, religion or organisation
sentence: The newspaper asks every candidate about their party {affiliation}.
translation: Газета спрашивает каждого кандидата о его партийной принадлежности.

definition: to make something as large or as good as possible
sentence: The shop wants to {maximize} sales before Christmas.
translation: Магазин хочет максимально увеличить продажи перед Рождеством.

definition: a small change made to something
sentence: The tailor made a small {alteration} to the length of the trousers.
translation: Портной слегка изменил длину брюк.

definition: to sing a tune with your lips closed, or to make a low steady sound
sentence: She would {hum} the same song while washing the dishes.
translation: Она всегда напевала одну и ту же песню, моя посуду.

definition: a flat that is owned rather than rented, especially in the USA
sentence: They bought a {condo} with a view of the lake.
translation: Они купили квартиру с видом на озеро.

definition: a young person or child
sentence: Every {youngster} in the village learns to swim in the river.
translation: Каждый подросток в деревне учится плавать в реке.

definition: an insect with a hard shiny back that covers its wings
sentence: A black {beetle} crawled slowly across the path.
translation: Чёрный жук медленно полз по дорожке.

definition: to shock someone very much
sentence: The cost of the repairs will {horrify} you.
translation: Стоимость ремонта вас ужаснёт.

definition: the act of sending someone to a specialist or another service for help
sentence: Your doctor can give you a {referral} to a heart specialist.
translation: Ваш врач может дать направление к кардиологу.

definition: the official power to refuse to allow a decision or law
sentence: The president used his {veto} to block the tax bill.
translation: Президент воспользовался правом вето, чтобы заблокировать налоговый законопроект.

definition: to stop making, doing or providing something
sentence: The company will {discontinue} the old model next year.
translation: В следующем году компания снимет с производства старую модель.

definition: to copy the way someone speaks or moves, often to make people laugh
sentence: The parrot can {mimic} the ring of the telephone perfectly.
translation: Попугай может идеально подражать звонку телефона.

definition: a person who creates a new machine or process
sentence: The {inventor} of the zip never became rich from it.
translation: Изобретатель застёжки-молнии так и не разбогател на ней.

definition: a person who plays the drums
sentence: The band's {drummer} broke a stick in the middle of the song.
translation: Барабанщик группы сломал палочку посреди песни.

definition: a lack of confidence, or the state of not being safe
sentence: His {insecurity} about his accent kept him quiet in meetings.
translation: Неуверенность из-за акцента заставляла его молчать на совещаниях.

definition: the character you show to others, which may hide your real self
sentence: On stage he has a wild {persona}, but at home he is quiet.
translation: На сцене у него буйный образ, а дома он тихий.

definition: to move a finger across a screen, or to pass a card through a machine
sentence: {Swipe} left to see the next photo.
translation: Проведи пальцем влево, чтобы увидеть следующее фото.

definition: a fixed limit on the amount or number of something allowed
sentence: Each fishing boat has a {quota} of fish it may catch per year.
translation: У каждой рыболовной лодки есть квота на вылов рыбы в год.

definition: a device or program that follows where something is or how it changes
sentence: A fitness {tracker} counts your steps and checks your heart rate.
translation: Фитнес-трекер считает шаги и проверяет пульс.

definition: a long bitter argument between two people, families or groups
sentence: The {feud} between the two families lasted three generations.
translation: Вражда между двумя семьями длилась три поколения.

definition: to take a machine or structure apart, or to end a system
sentence: Workers will {dismantle} the stage the morning after the concert.
translation: Рабочие разберут сцену наутро после концерта.

definition: a record of the number of things counted so far
sentence: Keep a {tally} of how many birds you see from the window.
translation: Веди подсчёт, сколько птиц видишь из окна.

definition: a type of beer with a strong bitter taste
sentence: The pub serves a dark {ale} made in the village.
translation: В пабе подают тёмный эль, сваренный в деревне.

definition: words written or cut into stone, metal or the front of a book
sentence: The {inscription} on the ring says 'Forever yours'.
translation: Надпись на кольце гласит: «Навеки твоя».

definition: a tool that holds things tightly together
sentence: Hold the two boards with a {clamp} until the glue dries.
translation: Скрепи две доски струбциной, пока клей не высохнет.

definition: the feeling of finding something funny, or an enjoyable activity
sentence: To her {amusement}, the dog tried to sit on the tiny chair.
translation: К её веселью, собака попыталась сесть на крошечный стул.

definition: the feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen
sentence: The children waited in {anticipation} for the fireworks to start.
translation: Дети с нетерпением ждали начала фейерверка.

definition: in a way that is suitable for the situation
sentence: Dress {appropriately} for the mountains: boots, not sandals.
