translation: Оденься по погоде для гор: ботинки, а не сандалии.

definition: believing you are better or more important than other people
sentence: The {arrogant} young doctor refused to listen to the nurses.
translation: Высокомерный молодой врач отказывался слушать медсестёр.

definition: official permission to do something
sentence: You need written {authorization} to enter the laboratory.
translation: Для входа в лабораторию нужно письменное разрешение.

definition: a person or thing that gives extra help or support
sentence: A nursing {auxiliary} helps patients wash and eat.
translation: Младшая медсестра помогает пациентам умываться и есть.

definition: the bags and cases you take when travelling, or problems from your past
sentence: Collect your {baggage} from belt number four.
translation: Получите багаж на ленте номер четыре.

definition: made of clay that has been baked hard
sentence: The kitchen floor has white {ceramic} tiles.
translation: На кухне пол из белой керамической плитки.

definition: the religious leaders of a church, considered as a group
sentence: The {clergy} of the city met to discuss help for the homeless.
translation: Духовенство города собралось, чтобы обсудить помощь бездомным.

definition: a state like deep sleep from which a sick or hurt person cannot be woken
sentence: After the crash he lay in a {coma} for three weeks.
translation: После аварии он три недели пролежал в коме.

definition: in a relaxed way without pain, or easily
sentence: The family lives {comfortably} on two salaries.
translation: Семья живёт в достатке на две зарплаты.

definition: an instrument with a needle that always points north
sentence: Without a {compass} we soon lost our way in the forest.
translation: Без компаса мы быстро заблудились в лесу.

definition: the feeling that someone or something deserves no respect
sentence: She looked at the liar with {contempt}.
translation: Она смотрела на лжеца с презрением.

definition: the study of how living things relate to each other and their environment
sentence: She studied {ecology} and now protects wetlands.
translation: Она изучала экологию и теперь защищает болота.

definition: the process of appearing or becoming known
sentence: The {emergence} of the internet changed how we shop.
translation: Появление интернета изменило то, как мы делаем покупки.

definition: the ability to keep doing something difficult or painful for a long time
sentence: Running a marathon is a test of {endurance}, not speed.
translation: Марафон — это проверка выносливости, а не скорости.

definition: relating to sexual desire and pleasure
sentence: The gallery showed {erotic} drawings from ancient Greece.
translation: В галерее выставили эротические рисунки из Древней Греции.

definition: to a much greater degree than usual
sentence: It has been an {exceptionally} cold winter this year.
translation: В этом году зима выдалась исключительно холодной.

definition: sexual attraction to people of the same sex
sentence: The country removed its old law against {homosexuality} in 1993.
translation: В 1993 году страна отменила старый закон против гомосексуальности.

definition: used when a situation is funny because it is the opposite of what you expect
sentence: {Ironically}, the fire station was the first building to burn.
translation: По иронии, пожарная часть сгорела первой.

definition: the unhappy feeling of wanting what someone else has or fearing to lose love
sentence: His {jealousy} of his brother's success ruined their friendship.
translation: Его зависть к успеху брата разрушила их дружбу.

definition: weighing more than is healthy
sentence: The doctor said the dog was {overweight} and needed more walks.
translation: Ветеринар сказал, что собака весит слишком много и ей нужно больше гулять.

definition: a serious illness in which the lungs fill with liquid
sentence: The old man was taken to hospital with {pneumonia}.
translation: Старика увезли в больницу с воспалением лёгких.

definition: very powerful or effective
sentence: The new drug is twice as {potent} as the old one.
translation: Новое лекарство вдвое сильнее старого.

definition: a title used before the name of a Christian priest or minister
sentence: The {reverend} will marry the couple on Saturday.
translation: Преподобный обвенчает пару в субботу.

definition: tasting strongly of the white substance added to food for flavour
sentence: The soup is too {salty}; add some water.
translation: Суп слишком солёный, добавь воды.

definition: careful and detailed examination of something
sentence: The minister's spending came under close {scrutiny} by the press.
translation: Расходы министра попали под пристальное внимание прессы.

definition: the form of a word used for one thing, or unusually great
sentence: 'Child' is {singular} and 'children' is plural.
translation: «Child» — единственное число, а «children» — множественное.

definition: a meal eaten in the evening, often a light one
sentence: We had soup and bread for {supper} and went to bed early.
translation: На ужин мы поели супа с хлебом и рано легли спать.

definition: affecting a whole system rather than one part of it
sentence: The report found {systemic} failures in how the bank checked loans.
translation: Отчёт выявил системные сбои в том, как банк проверял кредиты.

definition: the speed at which music is played, or the speed of an activity
sentence: The band picked up the {tempo} and everyone started dancing.
translation: Группа ускорила темп, и все пустились в пляс.

definition: needing or wanting to drink
sentence: After the long walk we were hot and {thirsty}.
translation: После долгой прогулки нам было жарко и хотелось пить.

definition: staying the same
sentence: The village has remained {unchanged} for a hundred years.
translation: Деревня не менялась сто лет.

definition: easy to understand, or normal and reasonable in the situation
sentence: Her anger was {understandable} after such a rude letter.
translation: Её гнев был понятен после такого грубого письма.

definition: standing straight up, or honest and responsible
sentence: Keep the bottle {upright} so the oil does not leak.
translation: Держи бутылку вертикально, чтобы масло не вытекло.

definition: too proud of your own looks or abilities, or without success
sentence: He is so {vain} that he checks every mirror he passes.
translation: Он так тщеславен, что смотрится в каждое зеркало по пути.

definition: too much pride in your own appearance or achievements
sentence: Out of {vanity}, she refused to wear glasses.
translation: Из тщеславия она отказывалась носить очки.

definition: useful or enjoyable enough to deserve the time or money spent
sentence: The long trip was {worthwhile} just to see her face.
translation: Долгая поездка стоила того, лишь бы увидеть её лицо.

definition: a very strong wish for something, especially food
sentence: She had a sudden {craving} for chocolate at midnight.
translation: В полночь ей вдруг страшно захотелось шоколада.

definition: a long step in walking, or progress made quickly
sentence: With one {stride} he crossed the narrow stream.
translation: Одним широким шагом он пересёк узкий ручей.

definition: to understand something wrongly
sentence: Please do not {misunderstand} me; I like the plan.
translation: Пожалуйста, не пойми меня неправильно, план мне нравится.

definition: to train a wild animal to live with people, or to control something wild
sentence: It took months to {tame} the horse enough to ride it.
translation: Понадобились месяцы, чтобы приручить лошадь настолько, чтобы на ней ездить.

definition: to break into very small pieces, or to slowly fail
sentence: The old walls {crumble} a little more every winter.
translation: Старые стены крошатся всё сильнее с каждой зимой.

definition: a dirty mark made by rubbing, or an untrue story told to damage someone
sentence: There was a {smear} of jam on the child's cheek.
translation: На щеке ребёнка было пятно от варенья.

definition: to become red in the face because you are embarrassed or shy
sentence: She began to {blush} when the teacher praised her poem.
translation: Она покраснела, когда учитель похвалил её стихотворение.

definition: a person who thinks deeply or has new ideas about important subjects
sentence: He was the greatest political {thinker} of his century.
translation: Он был величайшим политическим мыслителем своего века.

definition: a shop where bread and cakes are made and sold
sentence: The {bakery} on the corner sells fresh bread from six in the morning.
translation: Пекарня на углу продаёт свежий хлеб с шести утра.

definition: to completely destroy a building, or to prove an idea completely wrong
sentence: The council plans to {demolish} the old cinema next spring.
translation: Совет планирует снести старый кинотеатр следующей весной.

definition: a person or company that carries letters and parcels quickly
sentence: A {courier} will deliver the documents by noon tomorrow.
translation: Курьер доставит документы завтра к полудню.

definition: the act of keeping someone or something out
sentence: The {exclusion} of women from the club ended only in 1990.
translation: Запрет на членство женщин в клубе отменили только в 1990 году.

definition: to cut through something completely, or to end a relationship
sentence: The storm will {sever} the island's only link with the mainland.
translation: Шторм оборвёт единственную связь острова с материком.

definition: a poor part of a city where people of one race live, often by force
sentence: Thousands of families were forced to live in the {ghetto} during the war.
translation: Во время войны тысячи семей были вынуждены жить в гетто.

definition: a device that makes a loud warning sound, used by police and ambulances
sentence: The {siren} of the fire engine woke the whole street.
translation: Сирена пожарной машины разбудила всю улицу.

definition: a metal piece that joins a door to its frame so it can swing
sentence: Oil the {hinge} and the door will stop squeaking.
translation: Смажь петлю, и дверь перестанет скрипеть.

definition: a machine that copies pages onto a computer, or looks inside the body
sentence: Put the page face down on the {scanner} and press start.
translation: Положи страницу на сканер лицом вниз и нажми старт.

definition: to walk unsteadily as if about to fall
sentence: He managed to {stagger} to the door before he collapsed.
translation: Он сумел, шатаясь, дойти до двери, прежде чем упал.

definition: a chemical made of oxygen joined with another element
sentence: Rust is an {oxide} of iron.
translation: Ржавчина — это оксид железа.

definition: to turn something upside down, or to officially change an earlier decision
sentence: The appeal court decided to {overturn} the original verdict.
translation: Апелляционный суд решил отменить первоначальный приговор.

definition: the central part of an atom or cell, or the heart of a group
sentence: The {nucleus} of the atom holds almost all of its weight.
translation: Ядро атома содержит почти всю его массу.

definition: the line marking the side of a sports field, or an extra job
sentence: The coach shouted instructions from the {sideline}.
translation: Тренер выкрикивал указания с боковой линии.

definition: to become worse over time
sentence: His eyesight has {deteriorated} a lot in the last year.
translation: За последний год его зрение сильно ухудшилось.

definition: to dislike someone or something very much and have no respect for them
sentence: He came to {despise} the job he had once loved.
translation: Он возненавидел работу, которую когда-то любил.

definition: to pass a vehicle or person moving in the same direction
sentence: Never {overtake} on a bend where you cannot see the road ahead.
translation: Никогда не обгоняй на повороте, где не видно дороги впереди.

definition: a coin worth ten cents in the USA and Canada
sentence: The phone call cost a {dime} in those days.
translation: В те времена телефонный звонок стоил десять центов.

definition: a sea animal with a hard shell and two large claws, eaten as food
sentence: We ordered a whole {lobster} with butter to share.
translation: Мы заказали целого омара с маслом на двоих.

definition: a person who travels a long way to a holy place for religious reasons
sentence: Every {pilgrim} on the road carried a shell as a sign.
translation: Каждый паломник на дороге нёс ракушку как знак.

definition: the organ on the side of a fish through which it breathes
sentence: Water flows over the {gill} and the fish takes oxygen from it.
translation: Вода проходит через жабры, и рыба забирает из неё кислород.

definition: a slow relaxed walk for pleasure
sentence: We went for a {stroll} along the beach after dinner.
translation: После ужина мы прогулялись по пляжу.

definition: a strong chemical used to clean things or make them white
sentence: Use a little {bleach} to clean the stains off the sink.
translation: Используй немного отбеливателя, чтобы отчистить пятна с раковины.

definition: to talk or write about something with great enthusiasm, or to speak wildly
sentence: Critics {rave} about the young chef's new restaurant.
translation: Критики восторженно отзываются о новом ресторане молодого шеф-повара.

definition: words at the bottom of a film screen that translate or repeat what is said
sentence: Watch the film with the English {subtitle} on to learn new words.
translation: Смотри фильм с английскими субтитрами, чтобы учить новые слова.

definition: a large ring of wood, metal or plastic
sentence: The ball bounced on the rim of the {hoop} and fell in.
translation: Мяч отскочил от кольца и упал внутрь.

definition: a phone you can carry with you and use anywhere
sentence: My {cellphone} died halfway through the call.
translation: Мой мобильный разрядился посреди разговора.

definition: a very small village
sentence: The {hamlet} has six houses, a church and no shop.
translation: В деревушке шесть домов, церковь и ни одного магазина.

definition: an attempt to make someone believe you will do something you will not
sentence: His threat to leave was only a {bluff} to get a pay rise.
translation: Его угроза уйти была лишь блефом ради повышения зарплаты.

definition: relating to people born between about 1980 and 2000
sentence: The {millennial} generation grew up with the internet.
translation: Поколение миллениалов выросло вместе с интернетом.

definition: a piece of jewellery worn on the ear
sentence: She lost one gold {earring} somewhere in the taxi.
translation: Она потеряла одну золотую серёжку где-то в такси.

definition: an increase in speed, or the rate at which something speeds up
sentence: The car's {acceleration} from zero to a hundred takes six seconds.
translation: Разгон машины от нуля до ста занимает шесть секунд.

definition: the industry that builds aircraft and spacecraft
sentence: She works as an engineer in {aerospace} and designs wings.
translation: Она работает инженером в авиакосмической отрасли и проектирует крылья.

definition: using a continuous signal or physical hands, not digital numbers
sentence: He still prefers an {analog} watch with hands to a digital one.
translation: Он всё ещё предпочитает аналоговые часы со стрелками цифровым.

definition: an illness that makes breathing difficult
sentence: She uses an inhaler every morning for her {asthma}.
translation: Каждое утро она пользуется ингалятором от астмы.

definition: coloured lights seen in the night sky near the North or South Pole
sentence: We drove north for hours to see the {aurora}.
translation: Мы ехали на север несколько часов, чтобы увидеть северное сияние.

definition: caused by or relating to very small living things that can cause disease
sentence: The doctor said the infection was {bacterial} and gave her antibiotics.
translation: Врач сказал, что инфекция бактериальная, и назначил антибиотики.

definition: unable to pay your debts and legally declared so
sentence: The company went {bankrupt} after losing its biggest customer.
translation: Компания обанкротилась, потеряв крупнейшего клиента.

definition: behaving like a child in a silly way
sentence: It was {childish} of him to refuse to speak to her.
translation: С его стороны было по-детски отказываться с ней разговаривать.

definition: a small red or green pepper with a very hot taste
sentence: Add one {chili} to the sauce if you like it hot.
translation: Добавь один перец чили в соус, если любишь острое.

definition: a strong opinion in an argument, or disagreement between people
sentence: It is my {contention} that the bridge was never safe.
translation: Я утверждаю, что мост никогда не был безопасным.

definition: great love and loyalty to a person, cause or religion
sentence: The dog's {devotion} to its old master never faded.
translation: Преданность собаки старому хозяину никогда не угасала.

definition: happening at the end of a process or period
sentence: Nobody could have predicted the {eventual} winner of the race.
translation: Никто не мог предсказать, кто в итоге выиграет гонку.

definition: used to introduce the first point in a list
sentence: {Firstly}, the price is too high; secondly, the colour is wrong.
translation: Во-первых, цена слишком высока; во-вторых, цвет не тот.

definition: a strong wish for more money, food or power than you need
sentence: {Greed} drove the banker to steal from his own clients.
translation: Жадность заставила банкира красть у собственных клиентов.

definition: a red, swollen and painful area on the body caused by injury or infection
sentence: Ice will reduce the {inflammation} around the ankle.
translation: Лёд уменьшит воспаление вокруг лодыжки.

definition: hot liquid rock that comes out of a volcano
sentence: A river of {lava} flowed slowly towards the village.
translation: Поток лавы медленно тёк к деревне.

definition: having existed or been a particular thing for a long time
sentence: Her {longtime} partner finally asked her to marry him.
translation: Её давний партнёр наконец сделал ей предложение.

definition: a formal agreement between people, groups or countries
sentence: The two parties signed a {pact} to govern together.
translation: Две партии подписали пакт о совместном правлении.

definition: more important than anything else
sentence: The safety of the children is {paramount}.
translation: Безопасность детей важнее всего.

definition: wrongly believing that other people want to harm you
sentence: He became {paranoid} and thought his neighbours were spying on him.
translation: Он стал параноиком и думал, что соседи за ним шпионят.

definition: seeds of corn heated until they pop open, eaten as a light meal
sentence: We bought a huge bucket of {popcorn} for the film.
translation: Мы купили огромное ведро попкорна на фильм.

definition: relating to amounts and numbers rather than quality
sentence: The study used {quantitative} data from ten thousand patients.
translation: В исследовании использовались количественные данные десяти тысяч пациентов.

definition: copying a style from the past
sentence: The cafe has a {retro} look with 1950s chairs and a jukebox.
translation: У кафе ретро-стиль со стульями 1950-х и музыкальным автоматом.

definition: correctly or for a good reason
sentence: She was {rightly} angry that nobody had told her.
translation: Она справедливо злилась, что ей никто не сказал.
